title: Break open the king for perpetual check
text: Black threatens ...Qa2+. Sacrifice the rook on g7 to expose the king. Queen checks on g5 and f6 then repeat the position. Declining the rook allows a second sacrifice on h7 and another checking loop.
demonstration: Rxg7+ Kxg7 Qg5+ Kh8 Qf6+ Kg8 Qg5+
bookLines: Rxg7+ Kh8 Rxh7+ Kxh7 Qh3+ Kg6 Qg4+ Kh7 Qh5+

title: Liquidate into a wrong-bishop draw
text: Black sacrifices the knight for the dangerous b-pawn. After the bishop recaptures, the king heads for h8. White’s dark-square bishop cannot control the light-square promotion square, so the remaining rook pawn cannot win against correct defense.
